workspace.closeConfirm.body: Closing the tab stops this playground. Your code and files are not affected, and it runs again the next time you open it.
workspace.closeConfirm.optOut.hint: Tabs will then close and stop right away. You can turn the prompt back on in Settings › Editing and running.
workspace.closeConfirm.optOut.label: Don’t ask again
workspace.closeConfirm.title: Close {name} and stop it?
workspace.tab.close.label: Close {name}
